reviews.review:
I tried playing Warframe back in 2014 but wasn't a huge fan of the style. Additionally, the waiting mechanic to get new weapons as well as the limit of inventory space discouraged me.

I recently got back into playing it again and have found that those limitations quickly go away if you're willing to spend a bit of money (which is totally justifiable to me since the game is free).

Even if you don't want to spend money, you just need to be patient and eventually you can get whatever you want.

Pros:
1. The community in this game is 1000% better than most video games and is extremely friendly and helpful
2. The enemy/player design is fantastic
3. Movement is very fluid, fast, and fun
4. The developers actually interact with their community on a regular basis providing frequent updates, new content, and listen to player feedback and implement it VERY FAST. You can get a lot of free stuff just by participating in the community events as well.
5. NO FOMO. The downside of a lot of live service games is taking advantage of FOMO to get people playing every day. Warframe encourages you to log in, but does not make you feel like you lose out on not playing for hours.

Cons:
1. Repetition in missions. Ultimately, I think this can be a good thing, because it discourages me from playing non-stop and to take breaks (this is furthered encouraged by the crafting system) However, there are so many different kinds of activities and free quests that you can easily change what you are doing if you find yourself being bored.
2. PvP. Not a lot of effort put into this mode. Not really the focus of the game and could benefit from tuning and balancing or maybe just straight up reworking.
3. Slightly Predatory Store. It feels slightly predatory for new players that are presented with a real money value of an item that does not reflect it's in-game value. Although it is easy to find this information by asking or searching online, the store itself does not reflect this.
4. Overwhelming. This is really only true for new players. There's a decade worth of content to play through and can easily feel overwhelming. Highly recommend having a friend to play with (ideally someone who is familiar with the game)
5. Cosmetics. The end-game in Warframe is fashion! That being said, the variety of cosmetics available for immediate purchase seems to be small and I would love to see them go crazy with the designs and creativity!
